title: Z.ai Launches GLM-5.3 on Amazon Bedrock for Enterprise Coding
summary:
Business users can now deploy powerful coding and agentic tools by utilizing the most recent model from Z.ai hosted on the AWS cloud platform. The integration allows corporate clients to implement AI assistants designed for software development and autonomous tasks via the Bedrock service.

Zixuan Li described the release of GLM-5.3 as having been 'worth the wait' for those anticipating the update. The model is now live and available for enterprise adoption as of October 6.
